independent_acceptance.reason: The producer does not accept its own result. Only the coordinator may record COMPLETED and a different producer may accept or reject it.

limitations.text: The detector verifies inventory structure, file identity, and relation consistency; it cannot prove that a supplied CURRENT or SUPERSEDED standing was authorised by the correct institutional source. The caller must build the inventory from a separately resolved current pointer.

Byte equality and valid supersession metadata establish duplicate content, not semantic permission to delete a repository path. The detector only reports review candidates and exposes no deletion mode.
The reproduction uses four sanitized repository-native fixtures on one Linux runner. It does not claim whole-repository precision, cross-platform path behavior, or a production disposition.
No external source was read, and no claim about current third-party methods is made.
No GitHub Actions workflow was created or run because workflow paths are outside this unit's ownership. There is no workflow-run URL.

Per-subagent model and reasoning attestation are not exposed. The immutable input requested gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh/xhigh; runtime system identity is GPT-5.6 Sol; Cursor Cloud reports gpt-5.6-sol-max-fast for the enclosing controller run. These observations are not collapsed into an attestation.
Exact end-to-end wall time is unavailable. Individual test runners reported 0.021 seconds for 27 focused tests and 0.844 seconds for 37 seeded contract tests.
Immutable remote readback is performed only after the result and return commits exist; its exact receipt is carried by ready-to-commit.json and the terminal response.

artifact-manifest.json cannot contain its own SHA-256, and ready-to-commit.json cannot contain its own immutable return commit or hash. The custody chain records the manifest hash in ready-to-commit.json and the return-envelope hash and commit in the producer terminal response.
